text:
deploy-bot: RELEASE_HOLD: canary failed post-start healthcheck (service runtime). parity-check: staging started, prod crashed on config parse. marking release on hold :warning:

alex: pinging infra — what did the crash look like?

ops-runner: stack from canary pod: 
```
Error: Missing required config 'feature_toggle.default_behavior'
 at ConfigLoader.parse (/srv/app/config.js:87)
 at startService (/srv/app/server.js:45)
 Caused by: TypeError: undefined is not an object
```

tasha: quick check — staging's configmap has `feature_toggle.default_behavior: "opt-in"` set, prod configmap has `featureToggle: {}` (camelCase) from the values override. :grimacing:

priYA: omg — looks like helm chart change accidentally used camelCase key in the prod overlay. staging chart stayed with snake_case. I missed this in the values refactor PR.

marco: can we hotpatch the prod configmap to add the missing key? what's the risk?

ops-runner: risk: prod restart will roll canary -> smaller pool, but we have autoscale. We can patch and force a rolling restart, but releasebot already tried to promote image v1.8.0. If we patch, we should pin the image to previous stable (rwdw/runtime:1.7.2) until we validate chart overlay.

nina: timeline? we have a 02:00-04:00 UTC change window later tonight for larger infra work. prefer to avoid emergency patch during biz hours.

alex: decision options: 1) rollback to image 1.7.2 to unblock, keep release on hold and fix overlay in next deploy; 2) patch configmap now, validate canary, then continue with promotion; 3) postpone until change window and do controlled rollout. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

priYA: taking ownership of fixing overlay. I vote patch now (small change) + run validation script. If validation fails, rollback to 1.7.2.

tasha: +1 for patch now if we can run smoke and perf tests quickly. ops-runner, can you queue smoke-run on canary after patch?

ops-runner: will do. patch command I plan: 
```
kubectl -n prod patch configmap runtime-config -p '{"data": {"feature_toggle.default_behavior": "opt-in"}}'
kubectl rollout restart deploy/runtime-service -n prod --selector=release=canary
```
running smoke after rollout.

deploy-bot: ACTION: release status -> HELD. ticket created: ENG-4621. rollback tag: rwdw/runtime:1.7.2 pinned for emergency if smoke fails.

(15m later) ops-runner: patch applied, canary restarted. smoke checks: auth flows ok, token latency within SLOs, small 95p spike but within expected.

marco: verified logs — no more config parse errors. canary healthy for 5m. :thumbsup:

alex: great. plan: keep release held, merge overlay fix (PR 1289) to unblock next promote, but we need release notes: say "fix: normalize runtime config keys between environments; prevented startup crash when overlay missing feature_toggle.default_behavior" and add rollback instructions and change window note.

priYA: adding follow-up tasks: run automated parity check in CI (ENG-4622), add linter to catch camelCase vs snake_case keys in helm overlays (ENG-4623).

nina: schedule a 30m postmortem sync tomorrow 10:00 PT to review process + change window coordination.

alex: thanks everyone. leaving release held until PR merged and CI parity checks green. tagging @product-ops for heads up. :white_check_mark:
